title: 환경친화적 산업구조로의 전환촉진에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 산업통상부 (산업환경과), 044-203-4246
rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy ( Industrial Environment Division ), 044-203-4246

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「환경친화적 산업구조로의 전환촉진에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion of Transition to an Environmentally Friendly Industrial Structure and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(실태조사의 대상 등) ① 「환경친화적 산업구조로의 전환촉진에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제3조의2에 따른 실태조사(이하 “실태조사”라 한다)는 「통계법」 제22조에 따라 국가데이터처장이 고시하는 한국표준산업분류에 따른 광업, 제조업, 전기ㆍ가스ㆍ증기업과 그 밖에 산업통상부장관이 산업환경경쟁력의 강화가 필요하다고 인정하는 산업을 대상으로 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Fact-Finding Surveys, etc.) ① The fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 3-2 of the Act on the Promotion of Transition to an Environmentally Friendly Industrial Structure (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) (hereinafter referred to as the “Fact-Finding Survey”) shall cover mining, manufacturing, and the electricity, gas, and steam industries classified according to the Korean Standard Industrial Classification notified by the Minister of National Data Protection under Article 22 of the Statistics Act, as well as other industries that the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy recognizes as requiring the strengthening of industrial environmental competitiveness. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

② A survey on the actual conditions shall be conducted with respect to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 31, 2010; December 20, 2011; March 23, 2013; April 20, 2022; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업별 환경경제효율성, 자원생산성, 탄소중립 이행 현황 등의 실태에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the actual status of environmental-economic efficiency, resource productivity, and carbon neutrality implementation by industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 국내외 환경규범에 대한 국내 산업계의 대응 실태에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the current status of the domestic industrial sector's response to domestic and international environmental regulations

rows.source_ko: 3. 청정생산기술의 개발 및 보급, 청정생산 인력 수급 실태 등 청정생산에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning clean production, such as the development and dissemination of clean production technologies and the supply and demand status of clean production personnel.

rows.source_ko: 4. 재제조산업, 청정컨설팅산업, 제품서비스화산업에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the remanufacturing industry, clean consulting industry, and product servitization industry

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제2조제6호에 따른 생태산업단지의 자원순환에 대한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning resource circulation of eco-industrial complexes pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 6 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 환경설비산업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the environmental equipment industry

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 환경친화적인 산업구조로의 전환을 촉진하기 위하여 산업통상부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy to promote the transition to an environmentally friendly industrial structure

rows.source_ko: ③ 실태조사를 위한 통계의 작성서식과 조사방법 등 그 밖의 세부사항은 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Other detailed matters, such as the compilation format of statistics and survey methods for the fact-finding survey, shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3조
rows.text_en: Article 3
[Former Article 3 moved to Article 22 <December 20, 2011>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(청정생산지원협의회) ① 법 제6조제1항에 따른 기술개발사업의 추진, 법 제7조제2항에 따른 청정생산지원센터의 사업의 조정과 법 제8조에 따른 청정생산기술의 이전ㆍ확산에 대하여 산업통상부장관의 자문에 응하기 위하여 산업통상부에 청정생산지원협의회(이하 “협의회”라 한다)를 둔다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Clean Production Support Council) ① A Clean Production Support Council (hereinafter referred to as the “Council”) shall be established within the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to advise the Minister on the promotion of technology development projects pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the coordination of business of Clean Production Support Centers pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Act, and the transfer and dissemination of clean production technologies pursuant to Article 8 of the Act. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 협의회의 위원장은 산업통상부의 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 중에서 산업통상부장관이 지명하는 자가, 위원은 청정생산기술에 대한 전문가와 관계 행정기관의 공무원 중에서 산업통상부장관이 위촉하는 자가 된다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson of the Council shall be a person designated by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and the members shall be persons commissioned by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy from among experts in clean production technology and public officials of relevant administrative agencies. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 협의회의 간사는 「환경친화적 산업구조로의 전환촉진에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제6조에 따른 총괄주관기관의 직원 중에서 협의회의 위원장이 지명하는 자가 된다. <개정 2011. 12. 20.>
rows.text_en: ③ The secretary of the Council shall be a person designated by the Chairperson of the Council from among the employees of the overall supervising agency pursuant to Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of Transition to an Environmentally Friendly Industrial Structure (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”). <Amended Dec. 20, 2011>

rows.source_ko: ④ 그 밖에 협의회의 구성과 운영 등에 필요한 사항은 산업통상부장관이 정한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ Other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Council, etc., shall be determined by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(기술개발사업 관련 산업의 육성 촉진 지원기관 등) ① 법 제6조제3항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 기관”이란 법 제6조제2항 각 호에 따른 기관을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Support Institutions for Fostering and Promoting Industries Related to Technology Development Projects, etc.) ① In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the term “institutions prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to the institutions set forth in the subparagraphs of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제6조제3항제3호에서 “그 밖에 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2010. 5. 31., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 6, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act, “other matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 31, 2010; March 23, 2013; April 20, 2022; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 녹색제품의 생산 및 제품서비스화산업의 육성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the production of green products and the promotion of the product service industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 녹색제품의 판매 및 유통시스템의 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the establishment of a sales and distribution system for green products

rows.source_ko: 3. 저탄소ㆍ친환경 산업 활동에 소요되는 자금의 융자에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning loans for funds required for low-carbon and eco-friendly industrial activities
[Title amended Apr. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(녹색경영컨설팅사업 등의 육성사업 수행절차 등) ① 산업통상부장관은 법 제6조의2제1항 또는 법 제6조의2제2항에 따라 녹색경영컨설팅사업 또는 청정생산기술컨설팅사업의 육성사업(이하 이 조에서 “육성사업”이라 한다)을 수행하기 위하여 필요한 때에는 미리 육성사업의 수행계획에 대한 사항을 자체 게시판이나 인터넷 홈페이지 등을 이용하여 공고하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 5. 31., 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Procedures for Execution of Promotion Projects for Green Management Consulting Business, etc.) ① When necessary to carry out promotion projects for green management consulting business or clean production technology consulting business (hereinafter referred to as “ promotion projects”) pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2 of the Act, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy shall announce matters concerning the implementation plan of the promotion projects in advance using internal bulletin boards or internet websites, etc. <Amended May 31, 2010; March 23, 2013; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 육성사업의 수행계획과 결과 등에 대한 사항을 심의하기 위하여 산업통상부에 컨설팅사업육성심의회(이하 “심의회”라 한다)를 둘 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy may establish the Consulting Business Promotion Deliberation Council (hereinafter referred to as the “Council”) within the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to deliberate on matters concerning the implementation plans and results, etc. of promotion projects. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 육성사업의 수행과 심의회의 구성 및 운영에 필요한 세부사항은 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Detailed matters necessary for the execution of the promotion project and the composition and operation of the Deliberation Council shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Title amended May 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(청정생산지원센터의 사업) 법 제7조제2항제5호에서 “그 밖에 청정생산 지원과 관련하여 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 청정생산의 지원과 제품의 환경친화성 제고를 위한 조사 및 연구사업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Business of the Clean Production Support Center) In Article 7, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act, “other businesses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy in relation to the support of clean production” refers to survey and research projects aimed at supporting clean production and enhancing the environmental friendliness of products. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(청정생산지원센터의 운영) ① 산업통상부장관은 법 제7조제3항에 따라 청정생산지원센터가 수행하는 같은 조 제2항 각 호의 사업에 필요한 지도와 감독을 하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Operation of Clean Production Support Centers) ① The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energyshall provide necessary guidance and supervision regarding the projects set forth in each subparagraph of Paragraph 2 of the Act carried out by the Clean Production Support Centers pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act. < Amended Mar. 23, 2013 ; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 제1항에 따른 지도와 감독을 위하여 필요한 경우에는 법 제7조제2항 각 호의 사업에 대한 사업계획과 그 밖에 필요한 자료의 제출이나 보고를 명할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② If necessary for guidance and supervision pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy may order the submission of business plans and other necessary materials or reports regarding the businesses specified in each subparagraph of Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Act. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(청정생산기술의 이전ㆍ확산기관) 법 제8조제2항에서 “청정생산기술 업무를 전문적으로 수행하는 기관 등 산업통상부령으로 정하는 기관”이란 다음 각 호의 기관을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Institutions for the Transfer and Dissemination of Clean Production Technology) In Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the term “institutions prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, such as institutions that professionally perform clean production technology duties” refers to the institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제6조제2항 각 호에 따른 기관
rows.text_en: 1. Institutions pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「지방자치단체출연 연구원의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따라 설립된 지방자치단체출연 연구원
rows.text_en: 2. A local government-funded research institute established pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Local Government-Funded Research Institutes

rows.source_ko: 제10조(녹색경영추진본부의 사업) 법 제13조제2항제9호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 다음 각 호의 사업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Business of the Green Management Promotion Headquarters) The term “business prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” in Article 13, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 9 of the Act refers to the businesses set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국내외 녹색경영 우수사례 발굴 및 보급
rows.text_en: 1. Discovery and dissemination of best practices in green management at home and abroad

rows.source_ko: 2. 기업의 자발적 신청에 의한 업종별 녹색경영수준 평가
rows.text_en: 2. Evaluation of Green Management Levels by Industry Based on Voluntary Applications by Companies

[This Article was newly added on Dec. 20, 2011.]
[Formerly Article 10 was moved to Article 24 on Dec. 20, 2011.>]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(기업등의 녹색경영 지원) 법 제15조제2항제3호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 다음 각 호의 사업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Support for Green Management of Enterprises, etc.) In Article 15, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Act, the term “businesses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to the businesses set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 기업의 자원과 에너지를 절약하기 위한 제품의 생산 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Support for the production of products to save corporate resources and energy

rows.source_ko: 2. 녹색경영 관련 인력정보망 구축 등 인력 양성 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for workforce development, including the establishment of a green management-related human resource information network

rows.source_ko: 3. 녹색산업 관련 국내외 전시회 참가 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for participation in domestic and international exhibitions related to the green industry

rows.source_ko: 4. 기업 등의 녹색경영지원을 위한 국제협력
rows.text_en: 4. International cooperation to support green management in companies, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 기업의 녹색경영 수준 진단 및 개선 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Diagnosis of corporate green management levels and support for improvement

[This Article was newly added on Dec. 20, 2011.]
[Former Article 11 was moved to Article 25 on Dec. 20, 2011.>]

rows.source_ko: 제12조
rows.text_en: Article 12
[Formerly Article 12 moved to Article 26 <December 20, 2011>]

rows.source_ko: 제13조
rows.text_en: Article 13
[Former Article 13 moved to Article 23 <December 20, 2011>]
Article 14 Deleted <April 20, 2022>
Article 15 Deleted <April 20, 2022>
Article 16 Deleted <April 20, 2022>
Article 17 Deleted <April 20, 2022>
Article 18 Deleted <April 20, 2022>
Article 19 Deleted <April 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(산업환경정보망 구축 등의 대행기관) 산업통상부장관은 법 제17조제2항에 따라 산업환경정보망의 구축과 운영에 대한 업무를 다음 각 호의 기관으로 하여금 대행하게 할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2013. 12. 12., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Agency for Establishment, etc. of Industrial Environment Information Network) Pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energymay have the duties regarding the establishment and operation of the Industrial Environment Information Network performed by any of the agencies listed in the following subparagraphs. < Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 12, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가기술표준원
rows.text_en: 1. Korean Agency for Technology and Standards

rows.source_ko: 2. 「과학기술분야 정부출연연구기관 등의 설립ㆍ운영 및 육성에 관한 법률」 제8조에 따라 설립된 한국생산기술연구원
rows.text_en: 2. The Korea Institute of Industrial Technology established pursuant to Article 8 of the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutions, etc. in the Science and Technology Sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 「상공회의소법」에 따른 상공회의소와 대한상공회의소
rows.text_en: 3. Chambers of Commerce and Industry pursuant to the Chamber of Commerce and Industry Act and the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry

rows.source_ko: 5. 「민법」 제32조에 따라 설립된 비영리법인
rows.text_en: 5. A non-profit corporation established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act

rows.source_ko: 제21조(산업부문의 순환경제 촉진) 법 제20조제2항제5호에서 “그 밖에 산업부문의 순환경제를 촉진하기 위하여 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 다음 각 호의 사업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Promotion of Circular Economy in the Industrial Sector) In Article 20, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act, the term “other businesses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to promote the circular economy in the industrial sector” refers to the businesses set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 환경설비산업의 육성
rows.text_en: 1. Fostering the Environmental Equipment Industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 「산업발전법」 제16조제1항에 따른 자원생산성 목표관리제의 운영ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 2. Operation and support of the resource productivity target management system pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Industrial Development Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 공급망 산업원료 이용 및 제품생산의 효율성 향상에 관한 사업
rows.text_en: 3. Projects concerning the improvement of efficiency in the utilization of industrial raw materials and product production within the supply chain

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업자원관리전문기업의 육성
rows.text_en: 4. Fostering specialized industrial resource management companies

rows.source_ko: 5. 재생자원의 품질 제고를 위한 기반구축
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of a foundation for improving the quality of recycled resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 제품의 자원 이용 효율 평가 기반구축
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment of a foundation for evaluating product resource utilization efficiency

rows.source_ko: 7. 순환경제 활동의 온실가스 감축량 산정 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for calculating greenhouse gas reductions from circular economy activities

rows.source_ko: 8. 순환경제 우수 기술 및 제품의 보급ㆍ확산
rows.text_en: 8. Dissemination and expansion of excellent circular economy technologies and products

rows.source_ko: 9. 순환경제와 관련된 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 제공
rows.text_en: 9. Collection, analysis, and provision of information related to the circular economy

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 산업부문의 순환경제를 촉진하기 위한 사업으로서 산업통상부장관이 관계 중앙행정기관의 장과 협의하여 고시하는 사업
rows.text_en: 10. Other projects aimed at promoting the circular economy in the industrial sector, as notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies.

[This Article was newly established on Dec. 20, 2011.]
[Title amended on Apr. 20, 2022.]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(생태산업개발 촉진 사업의 지원방법 및 절차) ① 산업통상부장관은 법 제20조의2제1항에 따른 지원을 하기 위하여 생태산업단지의 사업계획과 실적의 평가 및 심사를 법 제20조의2제2항에 따른 전담기관이 수행하게 할 수 있다. <개정 2011. 12. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Methods and Procedures for Supporting Projects to Promote Eco-Industrial Development) ① The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energymay have a dedicated agency pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act conduct the evaluation and review of business plans and performance results of eco-industrial complexes in order to provide support pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Dec. 20, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 법 제20조의2제1항 각 호의 사업을 추진하기 위하여 생태산업단지와 관련된 자료를 제공하여 줄 것을 다음 각 호의 기관에 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2011. 12. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy may request the following agencies to provide data related to eco-industrial complexes in order to promote the projects set forth in each subparagraph of Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Dec. 20, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중앙행정기관ㆍ지방자치단체 및 그 소속 기관
rows.text_en: 1. Central administrative agencies, local governments, and their affiliated organizations

rows.source_ko: 2. 「공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 공공기관
rows.text_en: 2. Public institutions pursuant to the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions

rows.source_ko: ③ 그 밖에 생태산업개발 촉진을 위한 생태산업단지의 지원에 필요한 세부사항은 산업통상부장관이 기후에너지환경부장관과 협의하여 정한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Other detailed matters necessary for the support of eco-industrial complexes to promote eco-industrial development shall be determined by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy in consultation with the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

[Title amended Apr. 20, 2022]
[Moved from Article 3 Dec. 20, 2011>]

rows.source_ko: 제22조의2(생태산업단지의 지정 기준 등) ① 법 제21조제1항에 따른 생태산업단지의 지정 기준은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 22-2 (Criteria for Designation of Eco-Industrial Complexes, etc.) ① The criteria for designation of eco-industrial complexes pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 생태산업개발에 필요한 기업의 유치ㆍ집적이 가능할 것
rows.text_en: 1. It will be possible to attract and cluster companies necessary for eco-industrial development.

rows.source_ko: 2. 생태산업개발 촉진에 필요한 기반시설의 확보가 가능할 것
rows.text_en: 2. It will be possible to secure the infrastructure necessary to promote eco-industrial development.

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 법 제21조제1항에 따라 생태산업단지를 지정한 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 지정 내용을 관보에 공고하고, 산업통상부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy designates an eco-industrial complex pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall publish the details of the designation, including the matters in each of the following subparagraphs, in the Official Gazette and post them on the website of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생태산업단지의 명칭, 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: 1. Name, location, and area of ​​the eco-industrial park

rows.source_ko: 2. 생태산업단지에 추진될 주요 생태산업개발 사업
rows.text_en: 2. Major Eco-industrial Development Projects to be Implemented in the Eco-industrial Park

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 산업통상부장관이 공개할 필요가 있다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters that the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy deems necessary to disclose

rows.source_ko: ③ 그 밖에 생태산업단지의 지정 기준, 방법 및 절차에 필요한 세부사항은 산업통상부장관이 기후에너지환경부장관 및 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률」 제7조의4제1항에 따른 산업단지지정권자(이하 “산업단지지정권자”라 한다)와 협의하여 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Other detailed matters necessary for the standards, methods, and procedures for the designation of eco-industrial complexes shall be determined by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy in consultation with the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the authority designating industrial complexes pursuant to Article 7-4, Paragraph 1 of the Industrial Location and Development Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Industrial Complex Designating Authority”). <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제22조의3(생태산업단지의 지정 취소 등) ① 산업통상부장관은 법 제21조제7항에 따라 생태산업단지의 지정을 취소한 경우에는 산업단지지정권자에게 그 사실을 통보한 후 지정 취소의 내용을 관보에 공고하고, 산업통상부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 22-3 (Cancellation of Designation of Eco-Industrial Complex, etc.) ① In the event that the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy cancels the designation of an eco-industrial complex pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 7 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the authority designating the industrial complex of such fact, publish the details of the cancellation in the Official Gazette, and post them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제21조제7항제3호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 경우”란 5년 이상 생태산업개발사업을 추진하지 않은 경우를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 21, Paragraph 7, Subparagraph 3 of the Act, “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to cases where an eco-industrial development project has not been pursued for five years or more. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(품질인증 평가기관 지정서) 영 제21조제3항에 따른 평가기관 지정서는 별지 제5호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Designation Certificate for Quality Certification Evaluation Institution) The designation certificate for an evaluation institution pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 5.
[Wholly Amended Apr. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제23조의2(품질인증 평가기관의 지정취소 등) ① 법 제22조제8항제4호에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 경우를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 23-2 (Cancellation of Designation, etc. of Quality Certification Evaluation Institutions) ① The phrase “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” in Article 22, Paragraph 8, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to any of the following cases: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제22조제8항제2호 및 제3호에 따른 개선명령을 받고도 정해진 기간 내에 이를 이행하지 않은 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where an improvement order under Article 22, Paragraph 8, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Act is not complied with within the prescribed period

rows.source_ko: 2. 지정된 평가기관 스스로 지정취소를 원하거나 폐업한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where the designated evaluation institution voluntarily requests the revocation of its designation or ceases operations

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제22조제8항에 따른 평가기관의 지정취소 및 업무정지 기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The criteria for the revocation of designation and suspension of business of an evaluation institution pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 8 of the Act are as set forth in the attached table.

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업통상부장관은 평가기관의 지정취소 및 업무정지 처분을 하는 때에는 처분 집행 예정일 7일 전까지 처분 대상자에게 그 사실을 통지해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy revokes the designation of an evaluation institution or imposes a suspension of business, he/she shall notify the person subject to the disposition of such fact at least 7 days prior to the scheduled date of execution of the disposition. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 산업통상부장관은 법 제22조제8항에 따라 평가기관의 지정을 취소하거나 그 업무의 정지를 명했을 때에는 지체 없이 그 사실을 관보에 공고하고, 산업통상부 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy revokes the designation of an evaluation institution or orders the suspension of its operations pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 8 of the Act, he/she shall publish such fact in the Official Gazette without delay and post it on the website of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 20, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(재제조 제품의 표시 사항 등) ① 법 제23조의2제1항에서 “품질인증 표시 등 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2011. 12. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Labeling Requirements, etc. for Remanufactured Products) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, such as quality certification marks” in Article 23-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 20, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 품질인증제품명
rows.text_en: 1. Quality Certified Product Name

rows.source_ko: 2. 품질인증번호
rows.text_en: 2. Quality Certification Number

rows.source_ko: 3. 품질보증기간
rows.text_en: 3. Warranty Period

rows.source_ko: 4. 재제조사업자명 또는 재제조사업자를 나타내는 약호(略號)
rows.text_en: 4. Name of the remanufacturing business operator or abbreviation indicating the remanufacturing business operator

rows.source_ko: 5. 재제조일자
rows.text_en: 5. Remanufacturing date

rows.source_ko: 6. 품질인증을 표시하는 도표
rows.text_en: 6. Chart indicating quality certification

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제6호에 따른 도표와 품질인증의 표시방법에 대한 사항은 국가기술표준원장이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② Matters concerning the charts under Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 and the method of indicating quality certification shall be determined and notified by the Administrator of the Korean Agency for Technology and Standards. <Amended Dec. 12, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제23조의2제3항에 따라 재제조 제품을 생산하는 사업자가 재제조 제품임을 알 수 있도록 표시해야 하는 경우에는 제품ㆍ포장ㆍ용기 및 주변의 도안 등을 고려하여 제품 또는 제품 포장재의 정보표시면(용기ㆍ포장의 표시면 중 소비자가 쉽게 알아볼 수 있게 표시사항을 모아서 표시하는 면을 말한다)에 재제조 제품이라는 문자를 표시해야 한다. <신설 2022. 4. 20.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where a business operator producing a remanufactured product is required to indicate that the product is remanufactured pursuant to Article 23-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the words "Remanufactured Product" must be displayed on the information display surface of the product or product packaging material (referring to the surface of the container or packaging where labeling information is grouped and displayed so that consumers can easily recognize it), taking into consideration the product, packaging, container, and surrounding designs. <Newly added Apr. 20, 2022>

[Title amended Apr. 20, 2022]
[Moved from Article 10 Dec. 20, 2011>]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(전문연구기관의 지정 등) 법 제23조의3 각 호 외의 부분에서 “산업통상부령으로 정하는 전문연구기관”이란 다음 각 호의 기관을 말한다. <개정 2011. 12. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Designation of Specialized Research Institutions, etc.) In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 23-3 of the Act, the term “specialized research institutions prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to the institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 20, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「과학기술분야 정부출연연구기관 등의 설립ㆍ운영 및 육성에 관한 법률」 제8조에 따라 설립된 한국생산기술연구원
rows.text_en: 1. The Korea Institute of Industrial Technology established pursuant to Article 8 of the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutions, etc. in the Science and Technology Sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 「산업기술혁신 촉진법」 제42조와 같은 법 시행령 제53조에 따라 전문생산기술연구소로 설립된 한국자동차연구원
rows.text_en: 2. The Korea Automotive Research Institute, established as a specialized production technology research institute pursuant to Article 42 of the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act and Article 53 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업통상부장관이 기후에너지환경부장관과 협의하여 전문연구기관으로서의 장비 및 인력을 갖춘 기관으로 정하여 고시하는 기관
rows.text_en: 3. An institution designated and notified by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy in consultation with the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment as an institution equipped with the equipment and personnel of a specialized research institution
[Moved from Article 11 <December 20, 2011>]

rows.source_ko: 제26조(품질인증의 지원) 법 제23조의3제3호에서 “그 밖에 재제조 제품의 품질인증과 관련하여 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2011. 12. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2022. 4. 20., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Support for Quality Certification) In Article 23-3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act, “other matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy regarding quality certification of remanufactured products” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 20, 2011; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 20, 2022; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제20조제3항에 따른 품질ㆍ성능평가(인력과 장비지원의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Quality and performance evaluation pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree (applicable only to personnel and equipment support)

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제20조제3항에 따른 공장심사와 사후관리(인력지원의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Factory inspection and follow-up management pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree (applicable only to personnel support)

rows.source_ko: 3. 재제조 제품 품질인증의 효과분석
rows.text_en: 3. Analysis of the Effects of Remanufactured Product Quality Certification

rows.source_ko: 4. 재제조 제품 품질인증제도의 운영에 대한 개선방안의 작성을 위한 조사와 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Survey and research for the formulation of improvement measures for the operation of the remanufactured product quality certification system
[Moved from Article 12 <December 20, 2011>]
Article 27 Deleted <April 20, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <지식경제부령 제33호, 2008. 9. 29.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 33, Sep. 29, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2008년 9월 29일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on September 29, 2008.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 128, May 31, 2010>
